title: Zebra wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='15' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Zebra stripes on body -->
  <path d='M30 66 Q34 72 32 80' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 62 Q42 70 40 82' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 60 Q53 70 52 84' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 62 Q63 70 65 82' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 66 Q72 72 74 80' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='62' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='86' width='6' height='4' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='86' width='6' height='4' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='92' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='92' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M46 62 L44 42 L58 42 L56 62 Z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <path d='M47 58 L46 46' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 58 L55 46' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M36 30 Q32 26 34 20 Q38 24 38 22 Q40 18 42 22' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <path d='M46 20 Q48 16 50 20 Q52 16 54 20 Q56 16 58 20' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-20 38 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(20 62 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='2' ry='3.5' fill='#c88aa8' transform='rotate(-20 38 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='2' ry='3.5' fill='#c88aa8' transform='rotate(20 62 22)'/>
  <!-- Sunglasses -->
  <rect x='36' y='30' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <rect x='52' y='30' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <rect x='47' y='32' width='6' height='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <rect x='36' y='30' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4a4a8a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='52' y='30' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4a4a8a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M38 32 L42 35' stroke='#aaccff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 32 L58 35' stroke='#aaccff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#d0d0e0'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 51 54 48' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M76 68 Q84 62 82 74 Q80 82 84 86' stroke='#e8e8f0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 74 Q80 82 84 86' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
